task: Basal ganglia direct(D1/Go)/indirect(D2/NoGo)/hyperdirect push-pull gating circuit as a movement gain-control / winner-take-all gate on the cortically-selected action; dopamine (SNc) sets the D1/D2 balance. FALSIFIER (symmetric): reproduce the OPPOSITE-lesion double dissociation -- Parkinson's (SNc dopamine loss -> GPi/SNr output UP -> bradykinesia + beta 13-30Hz oscillations, L-DOPA/DBS rescue) vs Huntington's (striatal indirect-MSN loss -> GPi/SNr output DOWN -> chorea) -- while a collapsed single-channel ('ungated') null, forced to its strongest fair form (both sign branches), FAILS to reproduce both signs simultaneously.
